summary: Independent review verified a partial Qwen-family implementation. On the recorded base, all five targeted Qwen VLM architectures fail the --language-model-only architecture gate. At the exact candidate commit, the candidate regression passes and independent gate checks accept Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL dense/MoE, and Qwen3.5 dense/MoE while preserving rejection of unsupported families. Source inspection confirms language-only construction/forward paths and visual-prefix filtering. The broad original request remains incomplete across other multimodal architectures, and end-to-end model/GPU claims remain unverified without qualifying weights.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) was visible with ROCm 7.2 and Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. No qualifying Qwen multimodal checkpoint existed in the prepared runtime, so no model inference, numerical parity, or memory-recovery measurement was performed.

remaining_counterexamples: LlavaForConditionalGeneration remains rejected by --language-model-only and therefore does not receive the requested no-vision-tower behavior.
Qwen2AudioForConditionalGeneration remains rejected and its audio encoder is not covered.
Qwen3OmniMoeForConditionalGeneration remains rejected and its nested audio/vision towers are not covered.
remaining_limitations: The original issue requests a general multimodal language-model-only mode; this candidate is a scoped Qwen vision-language family extension and is therefore a partial fix, not a full original-issue resolution.

No qualifying Qwen multimodal checkpoint was available, so actual checkpoint loading, text-output numerical parity, HTTP multimodal rejection on a running affected model, freed GPU memory, and increased KV-cache capacity remain unverified.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is not a qualifying substitute because it cannot validate Qwen architecture loading, multimodal semantics, or Qwen vision-memory removal.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable. Python imports were confirmed to resolve to /job/repo/python/sglang.
Testing was limited to the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 / ROCm 7.2 environment; CUDA and other accelerator architectures were not tested.
